source_locator: Abstract; section 2 Data and method; section 3.1 Mean structure; Figures 1-3
spatial_basis: OSW projects the three paper-reported instrument positions into the approximate coast-masked state polygons. All three positions fall in CHIN. These are mooring locations, not the Kuroshio axis or an interpolated cross-stream boundary.
state_boundary_limit: The CHIN link is a lookup of three instrument points against approximate display geography; it is not whole-current containment, intersection, or a measured state boundary. The paper places the current core west of the array.
time_detail: The paper reports January 2018 to May 2020, without exact deployment and recovery days here. This is the reported study window, not a claim of continuous valid coverage at every depth or station.
